text:
incident-bot: PAGER → elevated 5xx/timeouts observed for inference-gateway (us-west-2). Spike started ~1781234500. Symptoms: repeated model-runner crashes (SIGSEGV) and OOM kills. Paging on-call. Please follow runbook: /runbooks/runtime-5xx. :rotating_light:

sarah: ack, I'm on it. dashboards show gateway 502s at 12:03 UTC, error-rate ~18% for /v1/generate. p95 latency doubling. Node gk-23 showing oom_kill events, container restarted 6x in last 10m.

mike: confirming logs: model-runner stderr contains repeated: "segfault at 0x7f... in quant_attention_kernel". Looks like quant kernel path tripping on long sequences.

terra: starting mitigation steps from runbook: 1) isolate offending runners, 2) route traffic to fallback model variant, 3) scale up healthy pool. Doing step 1: cordon node gk-23 and drain pods.

oncall: ack. Initiating routing change to fallback. Command: `POST /admin/routing` payload: `{ "route":"/v1/generate","policy":"fallback","fallback_model":"gpt-like-legacy-v2" }` — applying now. Will monitor error rate.

sarah: applied drain, but some in-flight requests still hit the crashed runner. Enabling short-term fast-fail: set env `INFER_FAST_FAIL=true` on gateway (reduces retry storm).

mike: for hotpatch: propose disabling quantized attention for model v3 on runners: set `DISABLE_QUANT_ATTENTION=1` and restart runner service. That avoids the segv while we build a proper kernel fix.

eng-ml: agree with workaround. Packaging a quick config diff and a rolling restart plan. Estimated safe restart window: 30s per instance, rolling with maxUnavailable=1.

support: customer impact: AcmeCorp (prod) and BrightApp (staging→prod roll) seeing ~20% request failures. CS already notified AcmeCorp, informing on rollback/reroute. Ticket IDs: AC-9876, BA-3344.

jordan: coordinating handoff — I'm taking night shift at 13:00 UTC. I'll watch reroute metrics and confirm rollback thresholds. Please call me if error-rate > 10% after 15m or p95 > 2s. @oncall please update pager rota.

terra: confirmed routing change reduced 5xx to ~6% within 2m. Scaling +2 runners in us-west launched. Applying `DISABLE_QUANT_ATTENTION=1` to 4/8 runners, continuing rollout.

sarah: pulled a core from /var/crash: attaching snippet: ```#0  0x00007f... in quant_attention_kernel
#1  0x0000555... in model_forward
#2  0x0000555... in serve_request``` Noting memory spike before crash: RSS jumped from 2.1GB -> 14.5GB in 800ms.

mike: likely regression from recent batching change that interacts poorly with quant kernels for long seqs. Opening PR to throttle max_batch_tokens for that model.

incident-bot: Incident severity -> SEV2 (partial customer impact). Created channel #incident-1781234567 and task: postmortem template.

support: continuing customer comms. ETA to stable baseline ~20-30m if rollout completes.

jordan: handing over to night team. I'll join postmortem prep in morning. If anyone needs live help ping me @jordan. Good job team :thumbsup:
